comment: Written against Claude Code 2.1.x (Ink TUI). Screens were transcribed from documented UI text and from the onboarding screens of an unauthenticated Claude Code 2.1.270 session; re-verified on 2026-10-27 against live Claude Code 2.1.308 sessions (Homebrew cask, driven through LM Studio's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, no Anthropic login, manual permission mode): idle prompt, spinner (including '✻ Waiting for API response · will retry in …'), the Bash permission dialog ('This command requires approval', 'Do you want to proceed?', '❯ 1. Yes', 'Esc to cancel · Tab to amend') and the idle prompt after a denied call classified correctly without a rule change; must be re-verified when Claude Code changes its TUI. Permission dialogs (Bash, Edit, Write, MCP) and the AskUserQuestion picker are BLOCKED; a tool call showing 'Running…' or the spinner status line ('✻ Thinking… (…)', with 'esc to interrupt') is WORKING — a '*' or '·' bullet ending in an ellipsis is answer text, not a spinner; the empty input prompt with '? for shortcuts' is IDLE. The onboarding menus (theme picker, login method) intentionally match no rule. Claude Code 2.1.308 draws on the alternate screen (earlier 2.1.x builds did not), and no rule depends on that flag.

anyLineRegex: Do you want to (proceed|make this edit|create|run|allow)
Do you want to allow this connection\?

rules.regex: (?i)Enter to (select|confirm)|Arrow keys to navigate|↑/?↓ to navigate|Review your answers
